paragraphs.source: This is the fate I choose.

paragraphs.source: No others were qualified to sit the throne of Denmark. It is time to let someone competent rule.

paragraphs.source: Who better than the woman who has seen all possible fates? Who else can have the power I hold?

paragraphs.source: I was once Cassandra, cursed to warn people and have them reject me.

paragraphs.target: 我曾是卡珊德拉，身负诅咒：向人们发出警告，却始终无人肯信。

paragraphs.source: Now I am Tyche, the goddess who makes her own destiny.

paragraphs.source: Fortinbras meets me in Elsinore's throne room, and for the first time we are able to speak as peers.

paragraphs.source: He agrees the war is senseless, so I cede him his little swamp, and we end it.

paragraphs.target: 他也认为这场战争毫无意义，于是我把那一小片沼泽割让给他，就此结束了战争。

paragraphs.source: Let him have it. Let him have it all. Men's pride will always be the end of them.
paragraphs.previous_target: 给他就是了。全给他就是了。男人的自傲总会让他们走向灭亡。

paragraphs.source: Denmark is smaller now, certainly, but all the richer—as Norway turns its focus to Sweden and the two tear each other apart.
paragraphs.previous_target: 如今丹麦的疆域确实小了，却也更加富足——挪威转而盯上了瑞典，两国斗得两败俱伤。
paragraphs.target: 如今丹麦的疆域确实小了，却也更加富足——挪威转而盯上了瑞典，两国斗得两败俱伤。

paragraphs.source: And all I had to do to avert that fate was listen.

paragraphs.source: The nobility are angry about taxation, about the flow of capital and power away from them. So I invite them to meet with me and I hear their grievances.
paragraphs.previous_target: 贵族们对税收不满，对财富和权力从他们手中流失感到愤怒。于是我邀请他们来与我会面，听取他们的怨言。
paragraphs.target: 贵族们对税收不满，对财富和权力从他们手中流失感到愤怒。于是我邀请他们来与我会面，听取他们的怨言。

paragraphs.source: At first, they think me unfit to rule. They argue over who ought to be King among them.

paragraphs.source: But averting war with Norway is a point in my favor. Unproven though I might be, I am a Queen.
paragraphs.previous_target: 但避免了与挪威的战争，让我多了几分优势。即使我的能力尚未得到证明，我也是女王。
paragraphs.target: 但避免了与挪威的战争，让我多了几分优势。即使我的能力尚未得到证明，我也是女王。

paragraphs.source: These days I am free of anger, free of ego or envy. I feel nothing at all.
paragraphs.previous_target: 如今，我没有愤怒，没有自负，也没有嫉妒。我什么都感觉不到。
paragraphs.target: 如今，我没有愤怒，没有自负，也没有嫉妒。我什么都感觉不到。

paragraphs.source: I have nothing to lose. I have lost it all a hundred times before. And in that, the nobles find respect for me.
paragraphs.previous_target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。我早已失去过一切，上百次。而这一点，让贵族们对我生出了敬意。
paragraphs.target: 我已经没什么可失去的了。一切，我早已失去过上百次。也正因如此，贵族们对我生出了敬意。

paragraphs.source: Claudius had moved to centralize power within the Danish crown and away from nobility.
paragraphs.previous_target: 克劳狄斯曾着手将权力从贵族手中收回，集中到丹麦王室。
paragraphs.target: 克劳狄斯曾着手将权力从贵族手中收回，集中到丹麦王室。

paragraphs.source: But now, I establish a system of checks and balances to ensure all parties have equivalent say.
paragraphs.previous_target: 但如今，我建立了一套相互制衡的制度，确保各方都有同等的话语权。
paragraphs.target: 但如今，我建立了一套相互制衡的制度，确保各方都有同等的话语权。

paragraphs.source: No king should have the power to sway a kingdom and begin a war as he pleases. I've already seen the kind of bloodshed which lies down that route.

paragraphs.source: Having earned their great respect, the nobility endeavor to work with me as much as possible.

paragraphs.source: We are able to enact incredible change. Things I never imagined possible when Claudius ruled alone.

paragraphs.source: Now and then, I hear rumors and insults. People think me cold. They whisper of the deaths which plagued our court, the deaths which made me queen.

paragraphs.source: They believe I ought to grieve more than I do. They wonder if a woman of my standing should ever have been made queen.

paragraphs.source: They wonder what happened to Ophelia, the girl—not Ophelia, the queen.

paragraphs.source: I know what became of the girl. Her future was stolen from her. She was forced to endure hell. And she came through it, alive but only half human.
paragraphs.previous_target: 我知道那个姑娘变成了什么样。她的未来被夺走了。她被迫承受地狱般的折磨。她熬了过来，还活着，却只剩下一半人性。
paragraphs.target: 我知道那个姑娘变成了什么样。她的未来被夺走了。她被迫承受地狱般的折磨。她熬了过来，还活着，却已不再是一个完整的人。

paragraphs.source: Over time, those whom I called friends pull away from me. They cannot relate to the world I live in now, and I don't ask them to.
